pull.title: mining: avoid checkBlock crash when chain has no tip
pull.body:
**The problem**: `Init.makeMining` returns as soon as the chainstate is loaded. On a first start with an empty datadir, or on a node started with `-reindex`/`-reindex-chainstate`, this is before the genesis block is connected, so the active chain has no tip. A `Mining.checkBlock` call in this window reaches `TestBlockValidity()`, which asserts that the tip exists, and the node aborts.

**The fix**: in `MakeMining`, if `wait_loaded` is set, wait for the chainstate to be present and for the tip to be non-null. 

*Alternative fix*: In `Mining.checkBlock`, check if the tip is present, return early with "inconclusive-no-chain-tip" otherwise. (I initially implemented this fix, but decided to go with the `makeMining` one instead, see https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36908#discussion_r4610682758)

The crash can be reproduced on master using the functional test included in this PR.

This is joint work with Turtlecute33 :)

events.message:
mining: avoid checkBlock crash when chain has no tip

Currently `Init.makeMining` returns as soon as the chainstate is loaded.
On a first start with an empty datadir, or on a node started with
`-reindex`/`-reindex-chainstate`, this is before the genesis block is
connected, so the active chain has no tip. A `Mining.checkBlock` call in
this window reaches `TestBlockValidity()`, which asserts that the tip
exists, and the node aborts.

Fix it by also waiting for the tip to be present in `MakeMining()` when
`wait_loaded` is set.

Co-authored-by: Daniela Brozzoni <danielabrozzoni@protonmail.com>

events.body:
In my last push (8cba4ba):
- Addressed https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36908#discussion_r4610682758
- Removed the unit test (it was covering the check that is now gone), added a functional test instead. Since the fix sits in `wait_loaded`, it made sense to test it next to the existing `createNewBlock` early-startup test.

ACK 8cba4bace8df92afcc9ff46404e36c741d557b64

`makeMining()` now waits for a tip the same way `createNewBlock()` and `waitTipChanged()` already do.

Code review ACK 8cba4bace8df92afcc9ff46404e36c741d557b64. This extends the #34661 fix to cover a case it missed. #34661 made `makeMining` wait for the chainstate to be loaded, but on a first start or with `-reindex`/`-reindex-chainstate` the chainstate is loaded before genesis is connected, and a `checkBlock` call in between still hits the `Tip()` assert in `TestBlockValidity`. `makeMining` now also waits for a tip using the same condition `AppInitMain` waits for before starting the node.

This bug was also reported in a [security review](https://ipcbugs.ofsky.org/audits/ar-42/) so nice to be able to close that issue.

Note for followup: the `Chain` interface that #29409 exposes over IPC has similar problems: `makeChain` returns right away, before `chainman` even exists, so it should get a similar fix.

comments.body:
Seems fine, but I think it would be better to not have to think about the tip being nullptr. This just adds mostly dead code that is practically only reachable in rare races or test envs.

Just waiting a millisecond more to load the genesis block seems conceptually easier?

<!-- Ref: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34661#discussion_r2892369478 for removing wait_loaded later
Right, thank you! I was very undecided between the two solutions, but I don't really see a reason for using Mining without a tip, so I agree that it's better to remove the check here.

In commit "mining: avoid checkBlock crash when chain has no tip" (8cba4bace8df92afcc9ff46404e36c741d557b64)

Note: It is safe to check `kernel_notifications.TipBlock()` inside this wait because `m_tip_block_cv` is notified whenever it changes in [`KernelNotifications::blockTip()`](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/8cba4bace8df92afcc9ff46404e36c741d557b64/src/node/kernel_notifications.cpp#L56-L57), which is called:

- On a first start or with `-reindex`/`-reindex-chainstate`, `blockTip()` when [`ActivateBestChain` connects genesis](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/8cba4bace8df92afcc9ff46404e36c741d557b64/src/validation.cpp#L3508-L3511) in the initload thread.
- On a normal restart, in [`LoadChainTip`](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/8cba4bace8df92afcc9ff46404e36c741d557b64/src/validation.cpp#L4675-L4681) before the chainstate is marked loaded, so the notify in [`setChainstateLoaded`](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/8cba4bace8df92afcc9ff46404e36c741d557b64/src/node/kernel_notifications.h#L63-L68) is the one that wakes this.

It's also notified on shutdown through [`Interrupt()`](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/8cba4bace8df92afcc9ff46404e36c741d557b64/src/init.cpp#L293-L294).
